properties.name: Anima-infused bark
properties.param: param_1784,This bark has been magically infused with Anima and is sought after by foresters. It is found during forestry events and is commonly used as a currency to buy other woodcutting-related gear from a forestry shop.

properties.name: Forestry kit
param:
param_1784,This equipable kit bag holds many items commonly used or found while woodcutting. There are two modifications available for it;
A log basket and sturdy harness will allow it to hold logs.
The clothes pouch allows it to store your lumberjack outfit.

properties.name: Funky shaped log
properties.param: param_1784,This log has grown into a pretty funky shape and has been infused with Anima. Feeding it to a beaver will unlock the beaver's ability to change colour when fed other types of logs. The type of log determines the colour that the beaver will adopt.

properties.name: Log basket
param: param_1784,The log basket allows you to carry more logs. When opened logs will automatically be deposited into it. The log basket can be combined with the forestry kit to make a single equipable item when used with the sturdy harness.

properties.name: Open log basket
param: param_1784,The log basket allows you to carry more logs. When opened logs will automatically be deposited into it. The log basket can be combined with the forestry kit to make a single equipable item when used with the sturdy harness.

properties.name: Log brace
properties.param:
param_1784,The log brace is used to make the sturdy harness. Which allows the forestry kit and log basket to be combined into one tool. You will also need:

45 Nails
2 Rope
3 Adamantite bars

75 Smithing
75 Woodcutting

properties.name: Nature offerings
param:
param_1784,These nature offerings are created by sacrificing high tier herbs.

Used by foresters for a chance at obtaining additional logs while woodcutting.

properties.name: Ritual mulch
properties.param:
param_1784,This component is used to make nature offerings which give extra logs while woodcutting. You will also need:

A high tier herb

50 Farming
68 Woodcutting

Makes 40

properties.name: Forester's ration
properties.param:
param_1784,The Forester's ration is made by preserving meat or fish in leaves.

The ration is automatically consumed while cutting trees to replenish your run energy.

This ration is also consumed when using felling axes, giving higher rates of XP.

properties.name: Secateurs blade
properties.param:
param_1784,The secateurs blade is an ingredient of the secateurs attachment, which allows you to collect more leaves when chopping trees. You will also need:

An iron bar

35 Smithing
35 Woodcutting

Makes 50

properties.name: Secateurs attachment
properties.param:
param_1784,The secateurs attachment allows you to collect more leaves when chopping trees.

The Attachments are made from Iron bars and secateurs blades, which can be bought from the forestry shop.

properties.name: Clothes pouch blueprint
properties.param:
param_1784,This blueprint is used as a pattern for creating your very own clothes pouch.

The clothes pouch, when used with a forestry kit, will allow the storage of the lumberjack outfit. You will also need:

Thread
Leather

50 Crafting
50 Woodcutting

properties.name: Leprechaun charm
properties.param:
param_1784,These charms attract the attention of leprechauns.

When you successfully chop down a tree, or chop down a tree with others, with this charm in a forestry kit there is a chance a leprechaun will offer his services.

properties.name: Clover insignia
properties.param:
param_1784,This insignia can be used to create a Leprechaun charm, which attract the attention of leprechauns when chopping down trees. You will also need:

An emerald
A ball of wool

70 Crafting
70 Woodcutting
35 Farming

Makes 10

properties.name: Bee on a stick
properties.param:
param_1784,The bee on a stick is helpful when pollinating plants.

While chopping trees, they have a chance to detect strange bushes that are ready to pollinate and will assist you in doing so.

properties.name: Powdered pollen
properties.param:
param_1784,This pollen can be used to create the common tool, Bee on a stick. Helpful for pollinating plants. You will also need:

A ball of wool
Logs
Close proximity to a bee hive.

50 Hunter
35 Woodcutting

Makes 10

properties.name: Cape pouch
properties.param:
param_1784,This pouch will allow you to store your woodcutting cape in your forestry kit.

The forestry kit will inherit the cape's increased chance at bird's nests when worn.

Requires a woodcutting level of 99 to use.

properties.name: Sawmill voucher
properties.param:
param_1784,This voucher can be redeemed for an extra plank per log cut at the sawmill.

Must be presented in person.

properties.name: Twitcher's gloves
param:
param_1784,These disposable gloves allow the wearer to nimbly dislodge birds' nests, giving them a greater chance of receiving their desired type of nest.

Sold in stacks of 250, one pair is used each successful chop.

properties.name: Smoker fuel
properties.param:
param_1784,Smoker fuel can be used to create Smoker canisters. Used to pacify wild bees. You will also need:

A Steel Bar
Leather

53 Smithing
53 Woodcutting
37 Herblore

Makes 10

properties.name: Smoker canister
properties.param:
param_1784,Smoker canisters are needed to pacify wild bees.

While chopping trees, they have a chance to pacify bees so the player can rehome them.

properties.name: Crystal charm
properties.param:
param_1784,This charm can be used to create a Petal circlet, which attract the attention of Dryads when chopping down trees. You will also need:

3 Flowers
A ball of wool

50 Fletching
50 Woodcutting

properties.name: Petal circlet
properties.param:
param_1784,These petal circlets can attract the attention of a Dryad.

When you successfully chop down a tree, or chop down a tree with others, with this charm in a forestry kit there is a chance a dryad will ask you for help.

properties.name: Padded spoon
properties.param:
param_1784,This Padded spoon helps carry pheasant eggs.

When you successfully chop down a tree, or chop down a tree with others, the Freaky Forester may seek your aid in collecting pheasant eggs.

Required to find the Golden pheasant egg.

properties.name: Egg cushion
properties.param:
param_1784,This tiny cushion is used in creating a Padded spoon, which helps carry pheasant eggs. You will also need:

Some Limestone
A Chisel

35 Crafting
25 Woodcutting

Makes 10

properties.name: Trap disarmer
properties.param:
param_1784,Trap disarmers are used to safely disarm fox poacher traps.

When you successfully chop down a tree, or chop down a tree with others, nearby foxes may seek your aid in avoiding poachers.

Required to find the Fox whistle.
